seedFolder.title: Seed folder
seedFolder.short: The folder of documents you know you want kept; Vespera keeps your other documents by how close they are to these.

degenerateOutputConfidenceFloor.title: Lowest text quality
degenerateOutputConfidenceFloor.short: PDFs and scans whose text came out with a quality mark below this number are left out of the pages.

degenerateOutputWordFloor.title: Fewest words a file must hold
degenerateOutputWordFloor.short: A file with fewer words than this is left out of the pages.

boilerplateDocumentFrequencyFloor.title: Repeated text
boilerplateDocumentFrequencyFloor.short: How common text must be, like a letterhead or footer, to be ignored when finding documents that say the same thing.

embeddingModel.title: Comparing model
embeddingModel.short: The AI model that measures how close documents are to your seed documents and to each other, which decides the groups.

relevanceScoreFloor.title: Relevance cut-off
relevanceScoreFloor.short: Documents less close to your seed documents than this number get no page; higher leaves out more.

arrangementApproved.title: Approved grouping
arrangementApproved.short: Vespera writes the pages only for the grouping of your documents you approve here.

generationModel.title: Writing model
generationModel.short: The AI model that writes the short introduction on each page; it does not change which documents are kept.

generationContextWindow.title: Writing model's reading size
generationContextWindow.short: How much of each group's text the writing model reads before writing that group's page.

clusterPageByteCeiling.title: Largest group page
clusterPageByteCeiling.short: A group's page larger than this many bytes is split into several pages.

logTimestampShareFloor.title: Leave out logs
logTimestampShareFloor.short: A text file with at least this share of lines starting with a time stamp is left out as a log.

extractionAttempt.title: Try number for unread files
extractionAttempt.short: Raise this by one and start Vespera again to retry files whose text could not be read.

codeNameEndings.title: Name endings that mark code
codeNameEndings.short: Text files ending in one of these, such as .java, are kept as code in the code/ folder, not in the pages.

outOfScopeNameEndings.title: Leave out files by name ending
outOfScopeNameEndings.short: Files whose name ends in one of these, such as .ok or .tmp, are left out and get no page.

translationSimilarityFloor.title: Translation match
translationSimilarityFloor.short: How alike two documents in different languages must be to count as translations; lower finds more but may pair wrong ones.

preferredLanguages.title: Preferred languages
preferredLanguages.short: When a document exists in several languages, only the copy in the first listed language that has one is kept.

configurationSettingShareFloor.title: Spotting configuration files
configurationSettingShareFloor.short: Text files made mostly of program settings are left out and get no page; this sets how mostly.

deliverableLanguage.title: Language of the pages
deliverableLanguage.short: The language your pages are written in: English or Italian.

clusterResolution.title: Grouping detail
clusterResolution.short: A higher number makes more, shorter pages; a lower number makes fewer, longer ones.

codeSetFolders.title: Code folders outside the documents folder
codeSetFolders.short: Code folders kept outside your documents folder; Vespera copies their code into the code/ folder in the Output folder.

foldersNotWalked.title: Folders not read
foldersNotWalked.short: Folders Vespera skips completely, so nothing in them reaches your pages; choose them in the Inclusions tab.

confluenceBaseUrl.title: Confluence site address
confluenceBaseUrl.short: The web address of the Confluence Cloud site that Publish sends your pages to.

confluenceSpaceKey.title: Confluence space
confluenceSpaceKey.short: The short code of the Confluence space your pages are published in, such as DOCS.

confluenceFolderId.title: Confluence page or folder to publish under, by its number
confluenceFolderId.short: The number, from its web address, of the Confluence page or folder that Publish puts your pages under.

confluenceFolderTitle.title: Confluence page or folder to publish under, by title
confluenceFolderTitle.short: The title of the Confluence page or folder that Publish puts your pages under; fill in this or the number, not both.

confluenceEmail.title: Confluence sign-in email
confluenceEmail.short: The email of the Atlassian account that Publish uses to put your pages on Confluence.
